Name: SuperWateringMod
Author: kasusa
Description:
English Version (英文版)
Description
Tired of refilling your watering can every few seconds while trying to water your massive farm? This mod upgrades your watering mechanics, allowing you to charge up and water a massive area at the absolute minimum cost!
Installation instructions
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it.[/*]
[*]Copy the extracted folder into your Stardew Valley
[code]Mods[/code]directory.[/*]
[*]Launch the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]Main features
[list]
[*][b]Super Charged Watering:[/b] Press and hold the action button to charge your watering can for a much larger AOE (Area of Effect) water splash.[/*]
[*][b]Extreme Water Efficiency:[/b] No matter how large the area you water via charging, [b]it only consumes exactly 1 unit of water[/b] from your can.[/*]
[*][b]No Extra Cost:[/b] No extra stamina or energy depletion. Just pure, efficient farming.[/*]
[/list]Requirements
[list]
[*][b]SMAPI[/b] - Stardew Modding API[/*]
[/list]Shout outs
Special thanks to ConcernedApe for creating this wonderful game, and the SMAPI community for providing the tools that make modding possible!
中文版本 (Chinese Version)
简介 (Description)
还在为大后期农场太大、原版洒水频繁需要跑去水槽加水而烦恼吗？这个轻量化模组彻底重构了浇水机制，让你可以通过蓄力进行大范围灌溉，同时将水资源的消耗压缩到了极致！
安装说明 (Installation instructions)
[list=1]
[*]安装最新版本的 SMAPI。[/*]
[*]下载本模组并解压。[/*]
[*]将解压后的文件夹整个复制到你的星露谷游戏根目录的
[code]Mods[/code]文件夹中。[/*]
[*]使用 SMAPI 启动游戏。[/*]
[/list]核心功能 (Main features)
[list]
[*][b]大范围蓄力浇水：[/b] 按住工具使用键即可进行蓄力，松开后能直接灌溉极广的大片农田。[/*]
[*][b]终极省水机制：[/b] 无论你蓄力开垦了多大面积的土地，[b]整套动作只会消耗洒水壶里的一格（1单位）水[/b]。告别频繁补水的痛苦！[/*]
[*][b]完全零额外消耗：[/b] 蓄力不会带来任何额外的体力（Energy）惩罚，纯粹的高效种田黑科技。[/*]
[/list]前置要求 (Requirements)
[list]
[*][b]SMAPI[/b] - 星露谷 Mod 加载器[/*]
[/list]致谢 (Shout outs)
感谢 ConcernedApe 带来的绝赞游戏，以及 SMAPI 开源社区提供的强大支持。祝大家护肝成功，祝作者的第二个 Mod 大火！
